name: Tinmorry
summary: Budget filament label distributed largely through Amazon and its own storefronts, emphasising metallic and silk specialty finishes alongside standard PLA and PETG. No legal entity or factory was identified; third-party reviews repeatedly flag batch-to-batch consistency problems.

product_lines.name: PETG
product_lines.notes: Standard, Metallic PETG, PETG-CF and PETG-GF

product_lines.name: ABS
product_lines.notes: Listed under the site's abs-filament product category

additional_notes: An alternate storefront exists at https://tinmorry.net/. Headquarters and manufacturing location are not disclosed by any source found; China origin is presumed from the distribution pattern and product design and is unverified. Rated Tier C by filamentcheatsheet at $14-28/kg, with polarised reviews — reports of catastrophic PETG blob failures alongside praise for good batches, plus customer-service disputes. Build plates: none found, so makes_plates is left unset. No OEM relationship to any brand in the verified-OEM file was found; the actual contract producer is unknown.

provenance.conflicts: No legal entity, HQ or manufacturing site was confirmed by any source; headquarters_country and manufacturing_countries are presumption from distribution pattern only and should be treated as unverified. Reviews disagree sharply on quality, ranging from total print failures to positive reports.
